|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Slave I, Symbol Of Fear (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V1-D-slaveisymboloffear-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-slaveisymboloffear022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/slaveisymboloffear.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/slaveisymboloffear.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “''Slave I''”. Text: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Power +1 for each opponent's starship here. While Jango or Boba Fett piloting, immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Slave I, Symbol Of Fear (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 3 October 2022<ref name="img-slaveisymboloffearca1ccff">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/slaveisymboloffear.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/slaveisymboloffear.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). While Jango or Boba Fett piloting, immune to attrition < 5.”
